## Administrative Experience
```{r admin, results='asis'}
if (exists("administrative") && !is.null(administrative)) {
  admin_data <- administrative %>%
    filter(!is.na(title)) %>%
    arrange(display_order, desc(start_date))
  
  if (nrow(admin_data) > 0) {
    cat("\\begin{cventries}\n")
    
    for (i in 1:min(nrow(admin_data), 10)) {
      title <- escape_latex(admin_data$title[i])
      inst <- escape_latex(admin_data$institution[i])
      dates <- format_date_range(admin_data$start_date[i], admin_data$end_date[i])
      
      cat("\\cventry\n")
      cat("{", title, "}\n", sep = "")
      cat("{", inst, "}\n", sep = "")
      cat("{}\n")  # Empty location field
      cat("{", dates, "}\n", sep = "")
      cat("{\\begin{cvitems}\n")
      
      # Main detail
      if (!is.na(admin_data$detail[i]) && admin_data$detail[i] != "") {
        detail_items <- strsplit(as.character(admin_data$detail[i]), ";")[[1]]
        for (detail in trimws(detail_items)) {
          if (detail != "") {
            cat("\\item ", escape_latex(detail), "\n", sep = "")
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Add impact if available
      if (!is.na(admin_data$impact[i]) && admin_data$impact[i] != "") {
        cat("\\item \\textit{Impact:} ", escape_latex(admin_data$impact[i]), "\n", sep = "")
      }
      
      cat("\\end{cvitems}}\n\n")
    }
    cat("\\end{cventries}\n")
  }
} else {
  # Fallback data
  cat("\\begin{cventries}\n")
  cat("\\cventry\n")
  cat("{Director of Online MS Finance Program}\n")
  cat("{University of Oklahoma}\n")
  cat("{Norman, OK}\n")
  cat("{2021-2024}\n")
  cat("{\\begin{cvitems}\n")
  cat("\\item Directed High Graduation Rate (>78\\%) Online Degree with approximately 150 students\n")
  cat("\\item Attained CFA Institute University Affiliation Program status\n")
  cat("\\end{cvitems}}\n")
  cat("\\end{cventries}\n")
}
```
